caption: #MyGerberPartner 🍂🎃 Fall adventures are even sweeter with my little girl! We spent the day exploring a 500-acre farm, picking out pumpkins, enjoying tractor rides, and making the sweetest fall memories! 🧡 And if you’re a toddler mom, you know snacks are a MUST! 😂 We packed our @Gerber fall-inspired Puffs to keep our little adventurer happy and fueled for all the fun. Her favorite? Sweet Potato Puffs! 🍠 From pumpkin patches to snack breaks, these are the little moments I never want to forget. 🥹🤎 What’s your favorite fall activity to do with your little ones? 🍁 #Gerber #FallFamilyFun #ToddlerMom #FallActivities
